market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI at $93-100 with intraday low $88.71 on May 7 (down 9% on Iran de-escalation). Reaching $115 in May requires ~15-25% rally in ~24 days. Geopolitical de-escalation + soft demand make this very unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran deal collapse or major supply shock in May
